guideRecapture.note: Built locally from the PR #417 head (main d1d8523 plus the guide restructure; the Editor sources are identical to the published fb5436f) because the public Pages host was not reachable from the capture environment. Served under /turbowarp-plus-editor/ and captured headless with Playwright Chromium in Japanese with default features. The sample project (sprites ネコ and ボール, variables 速さ and スコア, messages 開始 and ゲームオーバー, a generated 440 Hz tone) was built in the page through vm.loadProject and vm.addSound. catalog-current.png answers the catalog URL with entries rebuilt from the npm-published extension packages in the same way as turbowarp-plus-packages scripts/lib/extension-catalog.ts, and answers their jsDelivr URLs with the same npm bytes. review-dialog.png, form-dialog.png and validation-dialog.png open an SB3 that embeds examples/extensions/block-editor.ts (with a header declaring Unsandboxed: required) as a data: URL. The micro:bit hex download was replaced by a local placeholder, which does not affect the captured screens.
